newsitem.title: DUBAI: Al-Khazna Insurance leads UAE shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Al-Khazna Insurance leads UAE shares higher.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market rose in the week to Thursday, with good demand for the shares of a new insurance company, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi 27-share index ended the week over nine points higher at 2,377.12 points.
Shares of the new al-Khazna Insurance rallied up to 350 dirhams from 300 at the beginning of the week and brokers saw it bid as high as 380-400 dirhams.
The shares were issued late last month at 100 dirhams each.
Other popular shares were those of Dubai Investment Co and Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Co.
Dubai Investment shares were steady at 15 dirhams while Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding rose 10 dirhams to 43 dirhams.
Telecommunications company Etisalat rose five dirhams to 945, and Fujairah National Bank shares were also up five dirhams at 195.
